summary: Today’s market tone is broadly risk-on in crypto, with traders highlighting a mix of breakout continuation setups and selective altcoin rotation, while Bitcoin remains the anchor for direction. The clearest fresh themes are ZEC, PUMP, LIT, and Robinhood chain, alongside renewed attention on stronger alts and ecosystems; macro/FX sentiment is not well-covered in the available updates.
